name: Coyote jump off a plain ledge
techNote: A ground jump after the ground rays stopped hitting (coyoteFrames counting down from maxCoyoteFrames 6): the dot runs off a plain ledge and jumps up to 6 ticks later, off the edge it already left. The finish box is up and past the gap: only the coyote jump's 805 up reaches it, a fall passes under it.
